resources.evidence: Baremetal-IDE platform/penguin26/CMakeLists.txt PENGUIN26_UART_BAUDRATE default 115200, the rate the bench receiver used for the 100 MHz divisor-867 kits
Atlas RTL src/main/scala/atlas/scalar/ScalarCore.scala AtlasMemMap: VMEM_BASE 0x2000_0000, VMEM_SIZE 1.5 MiB in six 256 KiB banks; banks 3 to 5 are the compiler's data window by Atlas convention
external DDR controller on the SophiaLake board
Atlas RTL ScalarCore DMA addressing: dmaBaseReg concatenated with a 32-bit operand; with the upper half zero the operand reaches 0x80000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF

clocks.evidence: supplied by the carrier board: each row of carriers declares the clock it gives the chip, which selects the compiled UART divisor
accelerator frequency not established by selected sources

board_program.evidence: Both known DDR hosts load and start the chip over TSI and end the run on its tohost write: the FireSim tethered image (chipyard generators/firechip/chip/src/main/scala/Penguin26Configs.scala FireSimPenguin26BringupHostConfig, TSI bridge with loadmem into the bring-up DRAM, start and tohost over UART-TSI) and the SophiaLake bring-up host (bringup-chipyard afc886a fpga/src/main/scala/SophiaLake/Configs.scala WithUARTTSIClient). Puffin's host is unconfirmed

host_stack.evidence: Atlas deployment convention for the host core's stack, not the platform default (Baremetal-IDE platform/penguin26/penguin26.ld defaults to 128 KiB): the object stage refuses a generated stack bound above it, and library, startup, and trap frames are measured, not bounded

carriers.evidence: operator-stated clock of the on-chip JTAG bench board, unmeasured; its divisor-867 kits at 115200 baud passed on silicon on Nov 21, 2026

the FireSim tethered image runs the chip buses at 500 MHz: chipyard generators/chipyard/src/main/scala/config/EE290Configs.scala EE290BaseConfig WithUniformBusFrequencies(500.0), kept by generators/firechip/chip/src/main/scala/Penguin26Configs.scala FireSimTetheredPenguin26TL200Config, where only the bring-up side and the link run at 200 MHz
stated by the chip owner on Nov 22, 2026: the Puffin carrier runs the chip at 500 MHz; unmeasured

memory_regions.evidence: Atlas RTL src/main/scala/atlas/scalar/ScalarCore.scala AtlasMemMap: VMEM_BASE 0x2000_0000 plus three 256 KiB banks
Chipyard generators/chipyard/src/main/scala/config/EE290Configs.scala WithEE290TapeoutPeripherals: off-chip memory at 0x80000000; 1 GiB populated on the SophiaLake board
Atlas RTL ScalarCore DMA addressing with dmaBaseReg zero: a 32-bit operand from off-chip memory base 0x80000000
